messages.text: The source establishes three attack modes and shows that the program targets the first encrypted ZIP member when the selected index is unencrypted. The remaining compatibility boundary is exact Clap diagnostics plus archive/decryption messages; I’m narrowing those with focused source extraction and reference invocations before editing, because reproducing only successful password discovery would miss many benchmark-visible failures.
